name: Price Hunter
description: Fase 1: indeks harga pesaing vs harga jual EFN (laporan valid yang termatch ke produk; < 100 = pesaing lebih murah), kualitas laporan, dan produk dilaporkan yang belum termatch. Sumber: efn_dwh.v_price_index, v_price_hunter_*, v_competitor_prices.

cards.name: Laporan valid
cards.sql: SELECT sum(reports) AS laporan_valid FROM efn_dwh.v_price_hunter_quality WHERE status = 'valid' [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]]

cards.name: Indeks harga rata-rata
cards.description: Harga pesaing / harga jual EFN x 100.
cards.sql: SELECT round(avg(price_index), 1) AS indeks_harga FROM efn_dwh.v_price_index WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(competitor_name, {{competitor}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(efn_product_name, {{product}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Laporan valid termatch (%)
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(matched_reports) / nullIf(sum(valid_reports), 0) * 100, 1) AS persen_termatch FROM efn_dwh.v_price_hunter_match_rate WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]]

cards.name: Indeks harga per produk & pesaing
cards.sql: SELECT efn_product_name AS produk, default_code AS kode, competitor_name AS pesaing, count() AS laporan, round(avg(toFloat64(competitor_price))) AS harga_pesaing_rata2, any(efn_list_price) AS harga_jual_efn, round(any(efn_avg_pos_price_30d)) AS harga_pos_efn_30_hari, round(avg(price_index), 1) AS indeks, max(reported_at) AS laporan_terakhir FROM efn_dwh.v_price_index WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(competitor_name, {{competitor}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(efn_product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] GROUP BY produk, kode, pesaing ORDER BY indeks LIMIT 500

cards.name: Indeks rata-rata per pesaing
cards.sql: SELECT competitor_name AS pesaing, round(avg(price_index), 1) AS indeks FROM efn_dwh.v_price_index WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(competitor_name, {{competitor}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(efn_product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] GROUP BY pesaing ORDER BY indeks

cards.name: Tren indeks harga harian
cards.sql: SELECT day, round(avg(price_index), 1) AS indeks FROM efn_dwh.v_price_index WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(competitor_name, {{competitor}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(efn_product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cards.name: Kualitas laporan per status
cards.sql: SELECT day, status, sum(reports) AS laporan FROM efn_dwh.v_price_hunter_quality WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] GROUP BY day, status ORDER BY day

cards.name: Produk dilaporkan belum termatch
cards.description: Petakan ke SKU EFN (product_sku) atau samakan nama produk agar masuk indeks.
cards.sql: SELECT product_name AS produk_dilaporkan, competitor_name AS pesaing, count() AS laporan, max(reported_at) AS terakhir FROM efn_dwh.v_competitor_prices WHERE report_id NOT IN (SELECT report_id FROM efn_dwh.v_price_index) [[AND toDate(reported_at) >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND toDate(reported_at) <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(competitor_name, {{competitor}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] GROUP BY produk_dilaporkan, pesaing ORDER BY laporan DESC LIMIT 200

cards.name: Kesegaran data ETL
cards.description: Heartbeat ETL (SEC-52). Data dianggap basi bila menit_sejak_sukses > 30.
cards.sql: SELECT job, last_ok_at AS sukses_terakhir_utc, minutes_since_ok AS menit_sejak_sukses, last_status AS status_terakhir, failures_24h AS gagal_24_jam FROM efn_dwh.v_etl_freshness WHERE job IN ('competitor_prices', 'cycle', 'products', 'sales_fact_pos') ORDER BY job
